title: Balance Information
description: Response containing balance information returned to the TPP for one or more accounts.

Account.title: Balance information per account
Account.description: Account context and associated balance records within the balances response.

Account-Name.description:
Name or title assigned to the account.
- For GET Account, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Balance, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Transaction, this parameter is not required.
Account-Name.title: Account Name

Account-Number.description:
Account number of Citi's corporate client account.
- For GET Account, this parameter is required.
- For GET Balance, this parameter is required.
- For GET Transaction, this parameter is optional.
Account-Number.title: Account Number.

Account-Ref.description: **This parameter is required for GET Transactions and optional for GET Accounts and GET Balances.** Unique reference assigned to an account; when omitted (where optional), data is returned for all accounts linked to the client_id.
Account-Ref.title: Account Identifier

Account-Type.description:
Classification of the financial account.
- For GET Account, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Balance, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Transaction, this parameter is not required.
Account-Type.title: Account Type

Balance.title: Balance Details per account
Balance.description: Balance metrics for a specific account as returned by the balances endpoint.

opening_available_balance.description: SThis is the amount of money in your account at the start of the business day that is immediately available for use. It includes all settled transactions from previous days and excludes any funds that are on hold or pending settlement.
opening_available_balance.title: Opening available balance

closing_available_balance.description: This is the amount of money in your account at the end of the business day (EOD) that is available for use. It represents the opening available balance plus all settled credits and minus all settled debits from that day.
closing_available_balance.title: Closing available balance

intraday_available_balance.description: This is the available balance of your account reflecting transactions that have occurred during the current business day but before the official end-of-day processing.
intraday_available_balance.title: Intraday Available Balance

opening_ledger_balance.description: This is the book balance of your account at the start of the business day. It includes all transactions that have been formally posted to your account but may include items (like recently deposited checks) that have not yet cleared and are not part of your available balance.
opening_ledger_balance.title: Opening ledger balance

closing_ledger_balance.description: This is the book balance of your account at the end of the business day. It is calculated as the opening ledger balance adjusted for all credit and debit transactions posted during that day, regardless of their settlement status.
closing_ledger_balance.title: Closing ledger balance

intraday_ledger_balance.description: This is the ledger balance of your account reflecting transactions that have been posted during the current business day but before the official end-of-day processing.
intraday_ledger_balance.title: Intraday Ledger Balance

total_credit_amount.description: This represents the sum of all incoming funds (credits) posted to your account during the business day.
total_credit_amount.title: Total credit amount

total_debit_amount.description: This represents the sum of all outgoing funds (debits) posted from your account during the business day.
total_debit_amount.title: Total debit amount

net_amount.description: This is the net change in your account's balance for the day, calculated as Total Credit Amount minus Total Debit Amount.
net_amount.title: Net amount

opening_available_balance_eqv_ccy.description: This is your opening available balance converted into a different currency of your choice. The conversion is performed using the provided fx_rate.
opening_available_balance_eqv_ccy.title: Opening Available Balance in Equivalent Currency

closing_available_balance_eqv_ccy.description: This is your closing available balance converted into a different currency of your choice (e.g., viewing your INR account balance in USD). The conversion is performed using the provided fx_rate.
closing_available_balance_eqv_ccy.title: Closing Available Balance in Equivalent Currency

intraday_available_balance_eqv_ccy.description: This is your intraday available balance converted into a different currency of your choice.
intraday_available_balance_eqv_ccy.title: Intraday Available Balance in Equivalent Currency

opening_ledger_balance_eqv_ccy.description: This is your opening ledger balance converted into a different currency of your choice. The conversion is performed using the provided fx_rate.
opening_ledger_balance_eqv_ccy.title: Opening Ledger Balance in Equivalent Currency

closing_ledger_balance_eqv_ccy.description: This is your closing ledger balance converted into a different currency of your choice. The conversion is performed using the provided fx_rate.
closing_ledger_balance_eqv_ccy.title: Closing Ledger Balance in Equivalent Currency

intraday_ledger_balance_eqv_ccy.description: This is your intraday ledger balance converted into a different currency of your choice.
intraday_ledger_balance_eqv_ccy.title: Intraday Ledger Balance in Equivalent Currency

total_credit_amount_eqv_ccy.description: This represents the sum of all incoming funds (credits) posted to your account during the business day in equivalent currency.
total_credit_amount_eqv_ccy.title: Total credit amount

total_debit_amount_eqv_ccy.description: This represents the sum of all outgoing funds (debits) posted from your account during the business day in equivalent currency.
total_debit_amount_eqv_ccy.title: Total debit amount

statement_date.description: This is the specific date to which the balance information applies.
statement_date.title: Statement date

eod_date.description: This field indicates the date of the last business day that has been fully processed and closed for the account's specific region. Due to global time zones, this may be the previous calendar day (e.g., an account in Japan will have an EOD date of the 18th while it is still the 18th in the US).
eod_date.title: End of the day date

fx_rate.description: This is the foreign exchange rate used to convert the account's native currency balance into the equivalent currency (_eqv_ccy) amounts.
fx_rate.title: FOREX Rate

effective_rate.description: This represents the final, all-in exchange rate applied to the currency conversion, which may include any applicable spreads or transaction costs.
effective_rate.title: Effective Rate

intraday_last_update_date_time.description: This timestamp indicates the exact date and time (in GMT) when the intraday balance information was last refreshed.
intraday_last_update_date_time.title: Intraday Last Update Date Time

last_entry_date.description: This is the date on which the most recent transaction was formally posted to your account's ledger.
last_entry_date.title: Last Entry Date

Branch-Code.description:
Unique code identifying the servicing branch location.
- For GET Account, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Balance, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Transaction, this parameter is not required.
Branch-Code.title: Branch Code

Branch-Name.description:
Name of the branch or local bank location servicing the account.
* For GET Account, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Balance, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Transaction, this parameter is not required.
Branch-Name.title: Branch Name

Consent-Id.description: Unique identifier of the account information consent used to authorize TPP data access.
Consent-Id.title: Consent Identifier

Currency-Code.description:
Three-letter currency code defined by ISO 4217.
- For GET Account, this parameter is required.
- For GET Balance, this parameter is required.
- For GET Transaction, this parameter is not required.
Currency-Code.title: Currency Code

Legal-Entity.description:
Legal entity name associated with the account (individual, corporate, or institution).
- For GET Account, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Balance, this parameter is optional.
- For GET Transaction, this parameter is not required.
Legal-Entity.title: Legal Entity

Overdraft-Details.title: Overdraft Details
Overdraft-Details.description: Overdraft-related values associated with the reported account balance.

overdraft_amount.description: This field shows the portion of your balance that is currently utilizing an approved overdraft limit. If your account is not in overdraft, this will typically be zero.
overdraft_amount.title: Overdraft Amount
